Text.Text: That exceeded my boldest assumptions.
Outstanding!
Bravo!
Very well done.
Superb.
Allow me to congratulate you.
Don't be modest!
Outrageous!
Unacceptable!
A catastrophe!
So much for my good mood...
Excuse me, but are you out of your mind?
I'm sure you meant well.
i could find words to make you feel better but i won't
Please, be my guest.
The pleasure is all mine.
Oh, what a pleasant surprise!
it's no bother, I enjoy playing host.
Of course, stay as long as you like!
Well, I can spare some time. What do you need?
"Finish what you started" - You are familiar with that saying, I hope?
i can see progress. Slow... but it is progress.
What you waiting for?
Your will to prevail certainly deserves praise.
Formidable! In every sense of the word.
So much dedication.
You are responsible for this.
Seriously? This is what I invested in?
Not to put too fine a point on it ... horrible.
Leave me alone! Or is privacy a scarcity as well?
Not another word about my living conditions!
A little savoir vivre! Is that asking too much!
A booming city! I can hear crashing and exploding all around me.
This place is.. unacceptable.
This life... it ... it stretches me to the limit.
Not the center of the world... but I don't demand that either.
You know, there is nothing overly positive to say...
Well, I am used to more amenities.
A little... boring here, don't you think?
Ordinary...
Living here has some merit. Some...
Well... I haven't complained, have I?
Don't tell me you consider yourself truly satisfied with this.
Presentable... at least.
So, my investments did pay off.
Am I smiling? Of course!
It is a good life here, certainly.
Well, your city leaves little to be desired.
I am hard to please, so you should feel proud.
You're on the right path. I can say that much.
I saw the greatest of all cities. Well, actually i'm looking at it right now.
This place looks so beautiful, it makes me feel plain.
I'm not modest, but when I see your accomplishments, I can't help feeling small.
Just look at all this.
Ah, finally! A chance at entertainment.
Bread and Circuses. Some things never go out of fashion.
